name: Location Hotkeys
author: Captain Snail
description: Save locations for quick navigation with a radial menu or hotkeys. Requires the GHIRBI gatekeeper mod.
description_long:
[h2]Requires GHIRBI[/h2]
[b]Book of Hours will not load any DLL mod unless the GHIRBI gatekeeper mod is installed and enabled.[/b] That is the game's own consent gate for running third-party code. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3682369347]Subscribe to GHIRBI[/url], then enable it and Location Hotkeys in game.

[h2]Usage[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Hold or tap T[/b] to open the radial menu; select an empty slot to save a location, or an occupied one to pan there
[*][b]Page Up[/b] enters bind mode; press one of the ten location keys to bind the current view.
[*][b]Press U I O P J K L ; , .[/b] to jump to a saved view.
[/list]

[h2]Hotkeys[/h2]
All twelve keys are rebindable under [b]Options > Controls[/b], in a LOCATION HOTKEYS section below the base game's bindings.

[h2]Savegames and settings[/h2]
Each playthrough keeps its own locations. Hotkey configuration lives in [i]location_hotkeys.json[/i] next to your saves, with thumbnails in [i]location_hotkeys_previews/[/i]. Both are safe to delete.
